mapping_diagnosis.distinguishing_reason: The mapping of n2 (正方体) to '帅' is creative but the story does not explicitly establish that '帅' is a special case of all chess pieces (is_a relation from n2 to n1). The story says '帅是特殊的棋子' but does not clarify that it is a subtype of the general set of pieces, which weakens the is_a relation. Edge e1 (n1 is_a n3) is mapped to '按兵种分类', but the story's classification is performed on the pieces, not that the set of pieces is itself a classification; the direction is preserved but the relation is not fully explicit.
